task.title: Apply scaling practices to keep Insert Keyword pop-ups working in large DITA map sets
task.shortdesc: Standardize map organization and key management so Insert Keyword pop-ups remain reliable as the number of maps, topics, and keyspaces grows.

step.cmd: {'step': 'Centralize shared <keydef> entries into a dedicated keys map and reference it consistently from all root maps that authors use for editing.'}
{'step': 'Adopt a naming convention for keys (prefix by product/module) to prevent collisions as teams add new maps and shared terminology grows.'}
{'step': 'Limit deep mapref nesting where possible and document the intended key scope boundaries so authors know which root map must be opened for correct Insert Keyword behavior.'}
{'step': 'Automate validation in CI to detect unresolved keys, duplicate keys, and missing key targets before authors encounter missing Insert Keyword pop-ups.'}
{'step': 'Periodically purge/rebuild editor caches and indexes as part of workspace maintenance guidelines for large documentation sets.'}

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
